licenseText: GPL-2.0-or-later. Agent-drawn for the Diagram Design Notation project; copyright the DDN contributors.
note: Common-practice rendering — compliance against the governing standard pending document review. IEC 60617-style common set; the IEC 60617 document is not in hand, so forms follow well-known public renderings. Primary orientation only; rotate at bind time if needed.
